Abortion is essential, lifesaving healthcare. 

I suffered from post partum depression and post partum psychosis after the births of both of my sons. I became pregnant twice after they were born, and being able to access safe, legal abortion care allowed me to continue to care for them and myself without the constant fear of death by suicide, which was the primary symptom of my post partum mental health issues. 

Our veterans should have abortion care available to them through the V.A. so they can give their families and themselves the full, complete lives they rightfully deserve.

Furthermore, federal funding and Medicaid funding SHOULD NOT be allocated to crisis pregnancy centers. These fake clinics provide no real medical services, are not subject to inspections or licensing requirements, and pressure pregnant people to subscribe to religious indoctrination and forced birth manipulation. CPCs are dangerous facilities that practice deceptive tactics with people who are in very vulnerable situations. They have done nothing to merit the receipt of our tax dollars.
